parts.text: Outline briefly the principles of computed tomography (CT scanning).

parts.label: (b)
parts.text:
One section of a model designed to illustrate CT scanning is divided into four voxels. The pixel numbers $K$, $L$, $M$ and $N$ of the voxels are shown in Fig. 10.1.

{{figure:9702_w20_41_q10_figure_10_1}}

Fig. 10.1

The section is viewed, in turn, from four different directions $D_1$, $D_2$, $D_3$ and $D_4$, as shown in Fig. 10.1.

The detector readings for each direction are noted and these are summed to give the values shown in Fig. 10.2.

{{figure:9702_w20_41_q10_figure_10_2}}

Fig. 10.2

The background reading is 24.

Determine the pixel numbers $K$, $L$, $M$ and $N$ shown in Fig. 10.1.
